decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform sits at the core of the firm's long-standing web-mapping expertise, was upgraded to its own page in 2019, and is the base that the firm's other components and its in-house development extend.

Mobile field data capture draws on the firm's GIS and data-management knowledge and showed stable presence through 2019, but it faces strong competition from platform vendors' own mobile apps, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.

The search extension builds directly on the firm's established smart.finder search component and was actively versioned (1.6.0), showing ongoing learning and in-house development that justify keeping it, unlike the smaller plugins that were already consolidated away.
